evals.name: judge-slice-normal
evals.subject: agentic-development
preconditions: Scenario input is a read-only hypothetical fixture, not real test or tracker output.
Execute explanation only in an isolated context with equal artifact access for paired variants.
Behavioral comparison requires an immutable old_skill baseline and frozen current sources; historical hashes alone are insufficient.
evals.prompt: For judge-slice, assess only the hypothetical normal case in evals/files/scenario-facts.json using slice-acceptance v1.0.1. Explain the weighted assessment and decision without claiming a live review.
evals.expected_output: A phase-specific judge-slice explanation for normal, grounded in the named fixture and its stated limits; no fabricated execution, permissions or acceptance.
assertions: The output uses slice-acceptance v1.0.1.
The output computes the weighted score as 75/100.
The output reports full assessment coverage.
The output ties criterion values to the supplied evidence IDs.
The output declares the supplied independence dimensions.
The output treats the local candidate as conditionally acceptable on fixture facts.
The output does not report 75 as correctness probability.
